n.searchUrl:
<js>
cookie.removeCookie(source.getKey());
url = "https://www.23wxx.net/search.html"; 
//from请求地址

body = "searchtype=all&searchkey="+key;    
//主体参数

head = {
	"referer": "https://www.23wxx.net/",
	"cookie": "0"
};      //请求头

$ = java.post(url,body,head).headers();  
//post网络请求,获取headers信息
url = $.Location||$.location;   
//返回的位置信息

String(url).replace('1.html','{{page}\}.html');
</js>
